name: 灭火器配置计算（应急救援）

map.本计算器基于标准数学运算与单位换算约定，输入按数字格式解析，结果实时输出；纯前端: This calculator uses standard math and unit conventions; inputs are parsed numerically and results output in real time; fully client-side, no upload. Tool: Fire Extinguisher Configuration Calculation (Emergency Rescue).
map.根据保护面积、火灾类型和危险等级，按常用设计参数估算灭火器的配置数量。: Estimate the number of fire extinguishers required from the protection area, fire class and hazard level using common design parameters.
map.参考值基于常见设计经验：A 类轻/中/严重危险级分别按 100/75/50 m²: Reference values are based on common design practice: for Class A, light/ordinary/high hazard use 100/75/50 m² per extinguisher; for Class B, 1.5/1.0/0.5 m² per extinguisher. Each setting point should have no fewer than 2 extinguishers.
map.📚 深度解析：灭火器配置计算（应急救援）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Fire Extinguisher Configuration Calculation (Emergency Rescue)
map.新建车间按 GB 50140 估算所需灭火级别与具数，作为采购与布置清单的依据。: For a new workshop, estimate the required extinguishing rating and number of units per GB 50140 as the basis for the purchase and layout list.
map.场所改变火灾危险等级（如办公室改为仓储）后，复核原有配置是否仍然达标。: After a premises changes fire hazard level (such as office to storage), recheck whether the existing configuration still complies.
map.消防安全检查时按实际保护面积快速核对配置数量与设置点数是否满足最低要求。: During a fire safety inspection, quickly verify from the actual protection area whether the number of units and setting points meets the minimum requirements.
map.A 类轻危险级 300 m² 场所配置核算: Configuration check for a 300 m² Class A light-hazard premises
map.按默认参数（A 类火灾、轻危险级、保护面积 300 m²）：轻危险级单具保护面积: With default parameters (Class A fire, light hazard, protection area 300 m²): the light-hazard coverage per extinguisher is taken as 100 m², so 300/100 = 3 and about 3 units are estimated; laid out at 2 units per setting point, about 2 setting points are needed. Note that each setting point should have no fewer than 2 and no more than 5 units, and the spacing should keep the walking distance from any point to the nearest setting point within the protection radius.
map.为什么最少要配 2 具、且分设 2 个点？: Why at least 2 units, and why spread over 2 points?
map.GB 50140 要求每个设置点不宜少于 2 具，目的是一处灭火器失效、压力不足: GB 50140 requires no fewer than 2 units per setting point so that a backup remains if one fails, loses pressure or is cut off by fire; spreading them out ensures usable equipment near the fire origin and avoids long retrieval distances.
map.按可燃物数量、火灾蔓延速度与扑救难度分为轻、中、严重三级。同一建筑的不同区域可分: They are divided into light, ordinary and high hazard by the amount of combustibles, fire spread rate and difficulty of suppression. Different areas of the same building may be graded separately (for example ordinary hazard for offices, high hazard for storage), and each should be calculated at its own worst case and then summed.
